title: Fix gen keyword in Rust edition 2024 — use edition 2021
description: Change Cargo.toml edition to 2021 when gen keyword causes compile errors. Or use r#gen() syntax.
problem_statement: Rust compiler error: expected identifier, found keyword gen. Edition 2024 reserves gen keyword.
curator_notes: Critical pattern — models default to edition 2024 which breaks rand::Rng::gen().
